firstNightReminder: Announce that the Leviathan is in play. :reminder:
otherNightReminder: Change the Leviathan reminder token to the relevant day. :reminder: You may announce that the Leviathan is in play.

en.name: Leviathan
en.ability: If more than 1 good player is executed, you win. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.
en.flavor: To the last, I grapple with thee. From Hell’s heart, I stab at thee. For hate’s sake, I spit my last breath at thee.

revisions.v1: If more than 1 good player is executed, you win. All players know you are in play. After day 5, evil wins.

zh.name: 利维坦
zh.ability:
如果多于一名善良玩家被处决，邪恶阵营获胜。
所有玩家都知道利维坦在场。
在第五个白天结束时，邪恶阵营获胜。
